definition: גָּדַר verb wall up or off, build a wall (denominative? Late Hebrew id. , Arabic and see גָּדֵר below) — Qal Perfect גָּדַר Job 19:8 + 2 t., וְגָדַרְתִּ֫י Hos 2:8 ; Amos 9:11 Imperfect 2 masculine plural וַתִּגְדְּרוּ Ezek 13:5 Participle גֹּדֵר Isa 58:12 ; Ezek 22:30 plural גֹּדְרִים 2Kgs 12:13 ; 2Kgs 22:6 — wall up, shut off , literal only Participle , absolute = masons (wall-builders) 2Kgs 12:13 ; 2Kgs 22:6 also Isa 58:12 (object פֶּרֶץ ); figurative of Yahweh's dealings with men, object אֹרַה Job 19:8 , דֶּרֶך Lam 3:9 compare Hos 2:8 (accusative of congnate meaning with verb גָּדֵר ), in all = obstructing path of life, compare also Lam 3:7 (with בַּעֲדִי ); of restoring fallen booth of David Amos 9:11 (object פרצים ); of repairing fortunes of Israel, a work neglected by prophets Ezek 13:5 , and by all in power Ezek 22:30 (both with accusative of congnate meaning with verb)
